findings.description: Every active member must resolve through a non-disabled owning user and a CharacterCloudState whose character_id matches the map key; companion lease failures must not be reported as caller authentication failures.
The replayed field is always false, including on exact idempotent replay; remove the misleading field while this API is still unintegrated.
Add a server-boundary test proving that reserved high badge bits cannot satisfy the eight-badge Hoenn route.
